newsitem.title: GERMANY: BMW plans new German distribution unit.
newsitem.headline: BMW plans new German distribution unit.

text.p: German luxury carmaker BMW AG said on Wednesday that it had set up a new distribution group for the German market, where it sells around 35 percent of its cars.
Up until now distribution in Germany has been handled solely by the group's central European distribution wing. The new head of the distribution group will be Ralph Weyler.

BMW said the new organisation is modelled on similar distribution groups abroad. The new distribution group will remain under the aegis of BMW's central European distribution arm, which is headed up by Karl Gerlinger.
